@mixin themes {
  @each $palette, $modes in $palettes {
    @each $mode, $tokens in $modes {
      :root[data-theme='#{$mode}'][data-palette='#{$palette}'],
      .palette-preview[data-theme='#{$mode}'][data-palette='#{$palette}'] {
        @each $token, $value in $tokens {
          --#{$token}: #{$value};
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
